title: My Son Sold My Coffee Bus For $380K, Left Me $4K. So Every Sleeve Bears His Fraud Number.
description: My son stole the title to my vintage VW coffee bus, sold it for $380,000, and left me a $4,000 tip. I found our original partnership agreement hidden in the spare-tire well, proved forgery, and now he grinds beans in a shirt that says 'Grounds for Divorce' while every cup prints his fraud case number. #BrewedBetrayal #CoffeeJustice #FamilyRevenge
thumb_text: HE GRINDS BEANS IN 'GROUNDS FOR DIVORCE' SHIRT
pinned_comment: If your son stole your $115,000 investment, sold your dream for $380,000, and handed you a $4,000 'tip', what would you have done? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: AND LEFT ME A FOUR THOUSAND DOLLAR TIP
